description: Reviews AgenticJobs CLI commands that change a job board's state: posting or publishing a listing, submitting an application, and deciding on an applicant. Searching, reading drafts and listing applications stay automatic.
name: AgenticJobs command protection
saferAlternatives: Post a listing as a draft, read it back, and publish it as a separate reviewed step.
Read a prepared application or an applicant's record before submitting or deciding on it.
